system.longDesc: Provided as standard equipment for mech drivers, shuttle pilots, and similar professions, a decompression kit looks like a tiny ampoule with a switch on one side. The ampoule contains one dose of oxygenated artificial blood, which it can inject into the user to provide them with an additional number of rounds equal to their Constitution score before they take damage from suffocation or vacuum hazards. The switch is a panic button, which transmits a signal to any nearby ship requesting emergency airlock access. Most commercial ships allow this override of their airlocks, though military ships usually do not.
